admissible_source_evidence.variant_a: Entry for the well book. On the first morning of the week the well keeper drew from the well and set one jar sample on the north sill, labelled with the week mark. The rope and the winch were looked over, with no fraying found and no new wear, and the cover was seated square after the drawing. The next draw falls on the usual day next week and the well keeper will make it. The well keeper entered this in the well book the same morning. The yard pump is no part of this entry and keeps its own card.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b:
Well book entry.
- Drawn: first morning of the week, by the well keeper.
- Sample: one jar, set on the north sill, labelled with the week mark.
- Rope and winch: looked over; no fraying, no new wear.
- Cover: seated square after the drawing.
- Next draw: the usual day next week, by the well keeper.
- Entered in the well book by the well keeper the same morning.
The yard pump is no part of this entry and keeps its own card.
